ns2:course.label: Refrigeration and Cryogenics
ns2:course.description: The theory of operation and the design of equipment for the production of low temperatures from below ambient down to near absolute zero; applications to industrial, consumer, aerospace, medical, and various research uses. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ME 300, ME 310, and ME 320; or consent of instructor.
